title: The Little Cat Learns English
text: Bella was a little white cat. Every day she learned one new English word. One day she said "Hello!" and made her friend smile.

title: Rainy Day Story
text: It was raining. Tom stayed home and read books. He learned ten new words and felt proud.

title: The Magic Word
text: A girl found that saying "Thank you" made everyone happy. She used it every day and made many friends.
